# Vendored diStorm3 source

The files in this directory are from [diStorm3](https://github.com/gdabah/distorm), pinned from upstream commit `7a02caa1a936f0a653fc75f1aaea9bd3fa654603`. Copyright (c) 2003-2021 Gil Dabah. diStorm3 is distributed under the BSD 3-Clause license; see `COPYING`. It is used by 00047's `Wh_Disasm` adapter to decode x64 instructions and format Intel-syntax mnemonics and operands.
